digest.component_or_area: Jira adapter module reorganization & package loader
propositions: Eight Jira modules (acli*, adf, outbound_fields, comment_limits) must be moved from package root into adapters/jira/ per ADR 0035.

The loader's lazy_load() and spec_from_file_location() mechanisms must be taught relative subpaths for location-pinned modules (adf, outbound_fields, comment_limits) without breaking existing root-module dynamic loads.

All surviving dotted imports and sibling file references across the codebase (jira_fields.py, inbound_fields.py, acli_cli_ops.py, outbound_comments.py, inbound_translate.py) must be repointed to the new adapters.jira.* paths atomically, with no re-export shims.
Test suite patches and path constants (categories 2 & 3) must be rewritten to reference the new adapters/jira/ paths; path-agnostic object patches (category 1) remain unaffected.
The move must be atomic — staged without the loader edit confirms RED, and post-move grep finds zero references to old root paths (excluding path-agnostic _load_acli patches).
Full suite must pass green and module-size gate must validate that no src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/*.py exceeds 800 LOC after relocation.
